senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what cleans, purifies, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A refiner.
2 (In arithmetic,) The subtrahend.
E.
शुध to be pure, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Cleaning, purifying, &c., that which cleanses, refines, &c.
n. (-नं)
1 Cleaning, cleansing, purifying.
2 Correcting, freeing from faults or errors.
3 Correcting, as a writing.
4 Subtraction, (in arithmetic.)
5 The refining of metals.
6 A sort of refining, practised for chemical or medical purposes; exposing the metals to heat, and then sprinkling them with the urine of cows, &c.
7 Payment, acquittance.
8 Fæces, ordure.
9 Green vitriol.
m. (-नः)
The lime.
f. (-नी)
A broom.
E.
शुघ to be or make pure, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be corrected.
2 To be cleansed or purified.
3 To be refined.
4 To be subtracted.
5 To be liquidated (as a debt), due.
E.
शुघ to purify, aff. अनीयर्; also शोध्य and शोधितव्य.

ind.
1 Having paid or discharged.
2 Having cleared, &c.
E.
शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cleaned, cleansed.
2 Strained.
3 Corrected.
4 Refined.
5 Purified.
6 Discharged, liquidated, (as a debt.)
E.
शुध to clean, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 To be purified, cleaned, refined, &c.
2 Payable, due.
3 To be subtracted.
m. (-ध्यः)
An accused person, one to be justified or tried.
n. (-ध्यं)
A constant number to be subtracted in some astronomical computations.
E.
शुध to be pure, यत aff.
